name: PT Rans Entertainmen Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Rans Entertainmen Indonesia Tbk operates as an integrated lifestyle and media company. The company offers services, such as media and digital content creation, animation studios, creative agency services, event and production house services, sportainment, and talent and KOL management; and sells products, including beauty and personal care, and food and beverage items. It serves consumers and businesses in Indonesia. The company was founded in 2015 and is based in South Tangerang, Indonesia.
